narrative: Two black-letter bills on the post before the morning's work. Each has a title and the company under it. No author's name on either. No face.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the two bills and did not look for a name under either title.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
entities.context: Shown on bill in Two bills, and no author
